claims: March Madness 2026 takes place from March 15 to April 6.
The 2026 March Madness tournament has 67 games.
CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV will split coverage of the 2026 March Madness tournament games.
All games of the 2026 March Madness tournament can be streamed via the March Madness Live app.
Paramount+ streams all games broadcast on CBS for the 2026 March Madness tournament.
Max streams all games on TBS, TNT, and truTV for the 2026 March Madness tournament.
Hulu + Live TV includes CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV in its packages.
Fubo includes CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV in its packages.
DirecTV includes CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV in its packages.
The NCAA March Madness Live app allows streaming on Roku.
The NCAA March Madness Live app allows streaming on Apple TV.
The NCAA March Madness Live app allows streaming on Fire TV.
Selection Sunday for the 2026 March Madness tournament is March 15, 2026.
First Four for the 2026 March Madness tournament is March 17–18, 2026.
First and Second Rounds for the 2026 March Madness tournament are March 19–22, 2026.
Final Four and Championship for the 2026 March Madness tournament are April 4 and 6, 2026.
